Pláigh mhór do theacht le luing ar chuan Eassa Ruaidh.

Lethnucchadh don phláigh-sin h-i f-Fearaibh Manach,h-i t-Tír Chonaill,

& isin c-cúicceadh go coithchenn, & **Mac an Baird .i. Gofraidh,

Tire Conaill** d'ecc di, & dioghbhail mhor do deanamh di isin

c-cúicceadh uile.

M1478.12 Jump to heading ¶

**Mac Ritbeartaigh, .i. Ciothruaidh ollamh

Meg Uidhir lé dan**, **Tadhg Fionn Ua Luinín

saoí le leighes & le seanchas**, **Ua Breisléin Tadhcc mac

Eoghain ollamh Meg Uidhir

le breithemhnas**, & Ua Cobhthaigh Muirceartach Bacach d'écc.

M1478.13 Jump to heading ¶

Iondsaighidh do dhenamh d'Aodh Ócc Mácc Mathgamhna

's a lucht tighe ar Brian mac Remainn Meg Mathghamhna. Creacha mora do

dhénamh dó & Brian fein do gabhail i t-toraighecht na creiche.

M1478.14 Jump to heading ¶

**Maoileachlainn mac Aodha Buidhe Meg Eochagain tighearna

Chenél Fhiachach** do mharbhadh i n-a chodladh lá dís dia muintir fein

h-i c-Caislén Leth Ratha, & a losccadh búdhein i n-a c-cionaidh.

M1478.15 Jump to heading ¶

Emann mac Conchobhair Meg Raghnaill d'écc.

M1478.16 Jump to heading ¶

Uilliam mac Seaain Uí Feargail do mharbhadh d'urchor do

cuaille d'fior dia muintir féin.

M1478.17 Jump to heading ¶

Pláigh mhór i n-Erinn uile. Barun Delbna &

Mac Muiris Airig d'ecc di.

M1478.18 Jump to heading ¶

Fachtna Ua Feargail do marbhadh la mac **Emainn mic Hoiberd

Dalatun**.

M1478.19 Jump to heading ¶

Art mac Colmain Uí Maoileachlaind, & Mac Samhradhain .i.

Cathal mac Donnchaidh Ballaigh d'ecc.

M1478.20 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Feargail Uí Gadra, & Magnus Mac Dabhid do marbhadh la sliocht Ruaidri Mec Diarmata.

p.1108

M1478.21 Jump to heading ¶

Emann mac Taidhcc mic Lochlainn Uí Ainlighe do mharbhadh la

a chenél budh dhéin.

M1478.22 Jump to heading ¶

Caislen Sliccigh do gabhail lá Mac Uilliam Burc for

bardaibh Uí Domhnaill & a thabhairt do mac **Briain Uí

Concobhair**. Mac Uilliam Burc do thecht h-i Maigh Luircc iar

sin, & an tír do mhilleadh dhó, .i. cuid **Ruaidhri Mec

Diarmata**. Ruaidhri do dol for Cruachan

i n-a dioghail-sidhe i n-aghaidh Concobhair Mec Darmatta baí i n-a Mac Diarmata, & i n-a rann ag Mac Uilliam, & suidhe dhó as a h-aithle a t-timcheall na Cairrcce a f-forbhaisi, & sasa do chor chuicce do delbattar saoir tuccadh a Fearaibh Manach,

& aon mac Mec Diarmata do marbhadh d'urchor saighde as an t-sás sin,

& an Carracc do ghabhail tresan urchor-sin. Lain-tighearnas Maighe Luircc do gabhail

do Ruaidhri, & Conchobar do dhíbirt.

M1478.23 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh adhbal for Machaire Connacht. Feidhlim Fionn & **Ua

Conchobair Donn** do leith annsin, clann ócc **Thaidhcc

Uí Chonchobhair**, clann Feidhlim, & clann **Uí Concobhair

Ruaidh** don leith araill. An Machaire uile etir

chill & tuaith do mhilledh etorra. **Toirrdhealbhach Ruadh mac Ruaidhri mic

Feidhlimidh Uí Conchobhair** rogha mac ríogh do mharbhadh ar in c-coccadh-sin.

M1478.24 Jump to heading ¶

Tadhg mac Diarmada Ruaidh Uí Conchobhair do mharbhadh la

sliocht Briain Bhallaigh a mebail.

M1478.25 Jump to heading ¶

Gaoth adhbal do thurccbhail oidhche Nodlac Steill, & bá h-oidhche dilginn do cach í ar a mhéd ro mhudhaidh do

dhaoínibh & ceathraibh, chrannaibh, & chumhdaighibh uiscce &

tire seachnón Ereann.

p.1110

Annal M1479.

M1479.0 Jump to heading ¶

AOIS CRIOST, 1479.

Aois Criost, mile, ceithre ced, seachtmogatt, a

naoí.

M1479.1 Jump to heading ¶

Mainester Mhíleic do dhénamh la h-**Ua

Madagain** ar brú na Sionna i n-epscopóitecht Cluana Ferta do

Braithribh .S. Fronseis, & a togha fein innte.

M1479.2 Jump to heading ¶

Piarus mac Nioclais h-Uí Flannaccain baí i n-a chananach coraidh

h-i c-Clochar, i n-a phearsún & i n-a phrióir Ceile n-De i n-a Shacrista i n-Daimhinis, & i n-a oificel ar

Loch Eirne, saoí dhéshearcach chraibhdheach deigheinigh daonnachtach d'ecc iar m-breith bhuadha ó deamhan & ó dhomhan.

M1479.3 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór etir Cenél c-Conaill & Eoghain, uair do-chuattar clann Airt Uí Neill h-i t-Tir Conaill do

coccadh ar Ua Neill, & do-rónadh dioghbhala móra etorra.

M1479.4 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Néill do dhol ar ionnsaicchidh i t-Tír Conaill,

& creacha móra do thabhairt lais ó cloinn Airt & ó

Conallchoibh don turus-sin.

M1479.5 Jump to heading ¶

Brian mac Feilim Uí Neill do gabhail lá h-Ua Neill, & a leiccen amach iaromh.

p.1112

Fuaslaichthe mora do bhein as, & a dias mhac do braighdibh fri tairissi. Brian do dhol d'ionnsaiccidh ar Ua n-Domhnaill do coccadh

ar Ua Neill dhoridisi.

Annal M1480.

M1480.0 Jump to heading ¶

AOIS CRIOST, 1480.

Aois Criost, mile, ceithre chéd,

ochtmoghatt.

M1480.1 Jump to heading ¶

**Mag Uidhir, .i. Tomas Occ mac Tomais Moir mic

Pilip mic Aodha Ruaidh** fer ro ba mó deirc, crabhaidh, & eineach

baí i n-a aimsir fear cosanta a criche ar eachtaircheinealaibh, fear denma mainistrech, teampall & chailiseach fer ro

baí isin Roimh, & fo di h-i c-cathraigh SanSem ag a oilithre, d'écc, & a adhnacal i mainistir

in Chabhain iar t-togha dó innte.

M1480.2 Jump to heading ¶

**Mac Magnusa Meg Uidhir, .i. Cathal Ócc mac Cathail

Mhóir mic Giolla Pattraicc mic Magnusa** brucchaidh tocchaidhe

ei-sidhe d'écc iar m-buaidh ongtha & aithricche.

M1480.3 Jump to heading ¶

Maghnus Ruadh Ó Domhnaill do marbhadh le cloinn **Fheilim

Riabhaigh Uí Domhnaill**.

M1480.4 Jump to heading ¶

O Neill do dol ar ionnsaicchidh i t-Tír Conaill,loiscthe & dioghbhala iomdha do denamh lais.

M1480.5 Jump to heading ¶

O Domnaill do dol ar ionnsaicchidh i t-Tir Eoccain. Clann Airt Uí Neill & clann Fheilim Uí Neill do beith i n-a fharradh,

& creacha móra do denamh lais ar Mac Cathmaoil h-i c-Cenel Fearadhaicch &

Brian mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Ruaidh mic Enri Uí Neill do marbhadh

leó, & mac Mec Catmhaoil Semus. Do-rala Ua Neill co n-a cloinn

i n-a comfocraibh in tan-sin & ro lensat clann Uí Neill & Mac Cathmaoil

na creacha & ro marbhadh leo Eoghan mac Airt Uí Neill baoi h-i f-fochair

Uí Domhnaill saoí chinnfheadhna e-sidhe. Rucc Ua Domhnaill na creacha,

& soais dia tigh iar c-cosccar co n-edalaibh iomdha lais.

M1480.6 Jump to heading ¶

Eoghan Ua Domhnaill .i. Mac Neill Ghairbh, marbhadh la cloinn Nechtain Uí Domhnaill i c-Cluain Laogh

.i. an 29. do September & **Eoghan Caoch mac Magnusa

Ui Concobhair** do marbhadh i n-a fharradh & mac **Toirrdhealbhaigh Carraigh

Uí Conchobair** do gabhail ann bheós.

p.1114

M1480.7 Jump to heading ¶

Rudhraighe mac Rudhraighe mic Neachtain Uí Domhnaill do

marbhadh lá cloinn Neill Uí Domnaill.

M1480.8 Jump to heading ¶

O Domnaill do gabail coinne lé cloinn Neachtain, & le **Conn Ua

Neill** fa Caislén na Finne, & sídh do dhenamh dhóibh re 'roile, & tanaisdecht Tire Conail do

tabhairt d'Eiccneachán Ua n-Domhnaill.

M1480.9 Jump to heading ¶

Remann Riabhach mac Duinn mic Con Chonnacht Meg Uidhir, & **Mac Gille

Fhinnéin .i. Tadhg mac Briain** taoiseach ro b-fearr teach n-aoidhedh baoi i n-a athfhoccus d'écc.

M1480.10 Jump to heading ¶

Ua h-Eodhosa, .i. Aongus mac Seain saoí fhir dhána & Feargal Mac Eochadha deighfhear dana ele d'écc.

M1480.11 Jump to heading ¶

Corbmac mac Airt Chuile Meg Uidhir, & **Pilip Riabhach mac Amhlaoibh

Meg Uidhir** d'écc.

M1480.12 Jump to heading ¶

Art mac Rudhraighe Még Mathghamhna do mharbhadh ar deireadh creiche oidhche do-rinne sé féin isna Fedhaibh h-i fearann

Con Uladh mic Aodha Uí Neill.

M1480.13 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh etir cloinn Aodha Ruaidh Még Mathgamhna, & clann

Remainn Meg Mathghamna, creacha mora do dhenamh ar cloinn Remainn, & a

c-cur isin m-Breifne i c-cend h-Uí Raighilligh.

M1480.14 Jump to heading ¶

Sccaindear crodha etir cloinn Emainn a Burc, & clann **Riocaird A

Burc**. Bristear ar chloinn Emainn. Marbhthar mac Mec Dubhghaill na h-Alban (.i. Colla) d'aon urchor soigde & sochaidhe oile amaille fris an tan-sin.

M1480.15 Jump to heading ¶

Seaan Mec Gille Fhinnen .i. mac Briain, & tri fir

dhecc do muintir Cloinne Briain mic Pilip Meg Uidhir do marbhadh

acc Bealach Uí Mithidhein lá cloind **Uí

Ruairc**, Tighearnan & Brian Ruadh clann Tighearnain mic Taidhcc mic Tighearnain iad-sén.

M1480.16 Jump to heading ¶

Sluagh Gall do theacht i t-Tír Eoghain lá

Conn Ua Neill fa chaislén Sheaain Buidhe Ui Neill,

.i. iarla Chille Dara fer ionaid righ Saxan i n-Erinn, & Goill na

p.1116

Midhe ar chena. Seaan Buidhe féin do beith

isin c-caislen, & an baile do chongmháil, & do shesamh dó d'aimdheóin an t-sluaigh, & an sluagh d'imthecht

tar anais, & Seaan Buidhe do dhenamh siodha fri h-Ua Neill iar t-tain.

Annal M1481.

M1481.0 Jump to heading ¶

AOIS CRIOST, 1481.

Aoís Criost, mile, cethri cédh, ochtmocchat, a h-aon.

M1481.1 Jump to heading ¶

Brian mac Felim Uí Raghallaig, cend dámh & deóradh, & fear tighe aoídheadh coitcind d'écc.

M1481.2 Jump to heading ¶

Toirrdhealbhach mac Pilip mic Tomáis Még Uidhir do mharbhadh i fell an 5. do October i n-a

chaislén fein la **Donnchadh Occ mac Donnchaidh mic Aodha Meg

Uidhir** saoi choitcheann chomhlán ar eineach, ar aithne, & ar

uaisle, & a adhnacal i Mainistir Dhúin na n-Gall iar t-togha dhó inte.

M1481.3 Jump to heading ¶

Ua h-Anluain Feilim do marbhadh saoí chinnfhedhna ar uaisle & ar oirbeart e-sidhe.

M1481.4 Jump to heading ¶

Cathaoir Caomhanach mac Mec Murchadha do mharbhadh lásan c-Contae Riabhach.

M1481.5 Jump to heading ¶

Mac an t-Sabhaoisigh, .i. Pattraicc do gabail la **Conn mac Aodha

Buidhe**, & a dhalladh leis.

M1481.6 Jump to heading ¶

Sláine inghen Ui Bhriain ben **Mec Uilliam

Cloinne Riocaird** soidhtheach lán do dheirc & d'fhele, bean ro

dearsccnaigh do mhnáibh a h-aimsire d'écc iar m-breith bhuadha ó dhomhan & ó demhan.

M1481.7 Jump to heading ¶

Cu Chonnacht mac Seaain mic Con Connacht Még Uidhir, & **Feilim

mac Duinn mic Con Connacht mic Pilip mic Aodha Ruaidh Még Uidhir** d'écc.

M1481.8 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór d'eirge h-i t-Tir Eoghain etir Ua Neill & Seaann Buidhe Ó Neill. Clann Airt Uí Neill, &

clann Fheilim Uí Neill do beith i n-aghaidh Uí Neill ar in c-coccadh-sin. Clann Airt do denamh creiche ar cloinn Uí Neill & cland Uí Neill do denamh creiche no dó

ar Seaan Bhuidhe. Clantt t-Seaan Bhuidhe da lenmain

p.1118

& Aodh mac Cathail mic Feidhlimidh Uí Concobhair do mharbhadh

leo, & mac Giolla Pattraicc Mic Cathmhaoil co sochaidhibh oile nach airimhthear.

M1481.9 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac h-Ui Neill .i. Enri, do ghabhail lé cloinn **Aodha

Buidhe Uí Neill**, & a thabhairt h-i laimh **Ui

Dhomhnaill**.

M1481.10 Jump to heading ¶

Semus mac Maoilir Mec Hoirebert do mharbhadh lá **Gearoid mac

Emainn Geangcaigh Mec Hoirebert**.

Annal M1482. AOIS CRIOST, 1482.

M1482.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aoís Criost, mile, ceithre ched, ochtmoghat, a

dó.

M1482.1 Jump to heading ¶

Fioghair naomh chroiche an Coimhdeadh d'arthrucchadh & d'fagbháil ar brú locha Bhaile an Chuilinn. Fearta & miorbhalla iomdha do dhenamh dhi.

M1482.2 Jump to heading ¶

**Giolla Crist Ua Fiaich biocaire

Aire Brosccaigh** Saoí cleiricch & fear tighe aoidheadh

coitchind fri ré aon bliadhan décc do écc.

M1482.3 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac Aodha Buidhe Uí Neill tobar feile, & feichemh

coitcheann do cliaraibh Ereann, & Alban. Ceann

coccaidh & cosanta cirt a ceneoil, & rioghdhamhna an chuiccidh d'écc iar m-buaidh n-aithrighe.

M1482.4 Jump to heading ¶

Enri mac Con Uladh mic Aodha mic Eoghain Uí Néill do marbhadh la Gallaibh.

p.1120

M1482.5 Jump to heading ¶

Art mac Donnchaidh Meg Uidhir d'ecc.

M1482.6 Jump to heading ¶

Maol Mordha mac Cathail Uí Raighilligh do mharbhadh

lá cloinn Aodha Uí Raighilligh. Clann Aodha do theacht dia t-tir ar sith, Clann Cathail dia n-ionnsaighidh & tegh do gabhail forra, & dá mac Aodha & da mac Fheidlimidh mic Aodha do

marbadh co n-druing oile.

M1482.7 Jump to heading ¶

Brian mac Feilim Uí Neill do marbhadh la mac **Cuinn mec Aodha

Buidhe**, & la sliocht Enri Aimreidh. Ba saoí ar eineach ar eangnamh ar cennach duan & drecht an Brian h-íshin.

M1482.8 Jump to heading ¶

Donnchadh Occ mac Donnchaidh Meg Uidhir (las ro marbhadh

Toirrdhealbhach mac Pilip Meg Uidhir) do mharbhadh d'aon orchur

soighde.

M1482.9 Jump to heading ¶

Murchadh mac Taidhcc mic Cathail Óicc Meg Raghnaill do

mharbhadh la sliocht Airt Uí Ruairc.

M1482.10 Jump to heading ¶

**Diarmaid mac Lochlainn Óicc Uí Ainlighi

adhbhar toisigh Chenel Dobhta** do mharbhadh

co n-a bhraithribh a meabhail la sliocht Giolla na Naomh Uí Ainlighi, dar slánaibh mionn Connacht & druinge dia maithibh.

M1482.11 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri Buidhe Ua h-Ainlighi taoísech Chenél Dobtha d'écc iar seandataidh toghaidhe, & Tadhcc a bhrathair do ghabhail a ionaid.

M1482.12 Jump to heading ¶

Sluaigheadh dioghla lá **Ruaidhri Mac Diarmata tighearna

Mhoighe Luircc**, lá **Tadhg Mag Raghnaill

tighearna Conmaicne Mhaighe Rein h-i c-Cenél Dobhtha** iar m-briseadh a slán dia ro loiscceadh teach Uí Ainlighi, & dia ro marbhadh **Donnchadh

mac Siacusa Carraigh**, & mac Concobhair mic mic Corbmaic. Bresmhaidhm forra lasan tír co Béol an Atha Fada. **Feidhlimidh

Fionn Ua Conchobair** do thochar i n-aghaidh an mhadhma-sin & a chothuccadh dhó.

M1482.13 Jump to heading ¶

Brian Ócc mac Briain mic Cathail Duibh Uí Conchobhair

do marbhadh lá sliocht Taidhcc Uí Chonchobhair h-i c-Cuirreach in Araccail.

M1482.14 Jump to heading ¶

Maidhm i n-Ath na c-Cennaigheadh la h-**Art

Ua c-Concobhair** for Oiliuer Ploingcéd, & dream dia mhuintir do

mharbhadh, & Oiliuér fein do ghabhail.

p.1122

M1482.15 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall mac Rúdhraighe Uí Conchobair tighearna Corc Mo Dhruadh Ninais d'écc & Diarmaitt a brathair i n-a ionadh.

M1482.16 Jump to heading ¶

Feilim mac Feilim Uí Concobair Corc Mo Dhruadh do mharbhadh

a meabhail lá macaibh Conchobhair Uí Chonchobhair.

**Cairpre mac

Uí Conchobhair Ruaidh fear crodha coccthach, adbhar tighearna

sil Conchobhair Ruaidh** d'écc.

M1482.17 Jump to heading ¶

**Erard Ua Maol Chonaire ollamh Sil Muiredhaigh h-i

senchus, & h-i f-filidheacht** saoí e-sidhe i l-Laidin & i n-Gaoidhilcc d'écc iar m-buaidh ó dhomhan, & o

dheamhan & a adhnacal i n-Oil Finn, & Siodhraidh Ua Maol Conaire i n-a ionad.

M1482.18 Jump to heading ¶

Muirchertach Mac Flannchadha adhbhar ollamhan Tuadhmumhan &

an Cosnamhach mac Conchobhair Óicc Mec Flannchadha d'écc.

M1482.19 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Cairpre Uí Concobhar do mharbhadh la dreim dia muintir feissin.

AOIS CRIOST, 1483.

M1483.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aois Criost, Mile, ceithre ced, ochtmoghat a

trí.

M1483.1 Jump to heading ¶

**Rossa mac Tomais Óicc Még Uidhir Epscop

Clochair**, saoí i n-eccna, & i c-crabhaidh fear ticche aoidhedh

coitchinn dá gach aon d'écc, & a adnacal i t-tempall Achaidh Urchoir do reir a thogha budh dhéin.

M1483.2 Jump to heading ¶

Mathgamhain Ua Griobhtha Epscop Chille Dá Lua tobar féile & eccna d'écc, & a adhnacal i mainistir na c-Cananach h-i

c-Corco Baisccind co h-onorach.

p.1124

M1483.3 Jump to heading ¶

Donnchadh mac Uí Cheallaigh, & **O Ferghail, .i.

Cú Mara** d'écc.

M1483.4 Jump to heading ¶

Conn Ó Néill d'fuaslaccadh lá a athair & lá a bhraithribh ó

Ua n-Domhnaill & ó Chloinn Aodha Buidhe, & an

Conn-sin iaramh d'oirdneadh i n-a thighearna ar Tir Eogain do

thoil a athar & Tire h-Eoghain archena.

M1483.5 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór do eirghe eitir Ua n-Domhnaill Aodh Ruadh, &

Ó Neill Conn. Ua Domhnaill do thionól Chineóil c-Conaill & Iochtair Connacht. **Aodh Ócc mac Aodha

Buidhe Uí Neill** co líon a thionóil do thecht i n-a chomhdhail & dol rempa i n-a remim

imteachta gan tuilleadh buidhe re h-esccaraitt da raibh rempa co Traigh Bhaile Dúine Dealgan. Aircctear & loiscctear leó an baile & an

tír i n-a t-timcheal. Rucc an **Iustis .i. Gearoid mac Tomais

iarla Cille Dara**, co sochraitte móir

Gall forra dia t-tograim & dia t-toraighecht. Ar a aí ro iomchuirsiotsomh an tóir throm sin co neimhsniomhach & do

sraoíneadh forra, & do marbhadh drong mhór do Ghallaibh. Cidh iad-somh dna ro marbhadh

Mac Uidhilin & mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Charraigh Uí Concobhair uatha. Luidh Ua Domhnaill co n-a

sochraitte iaromh co Baile Lucchmaigh & loiscctear

Baile Lucchmaigh lais & fo gheibh comha & ceannach dar cenn imdheghla &

anacail dia m-baile. Soais Ua Domhnaill tar a ais, & ro léicc **Aodh Ócc mac

Aedha Buidhe** uadha co Glendrighe d'ionnsaicchidh

Thrín Congail. Ro gabh fein reimhe tré Thír Eoghain.

Milltear & loiscctear leis an tír i n-a comhfoccus dá gach leth co rainicc Abhann Mhór.Ro tesccadh & ro gerradh leo coillte daingne doimteachta do rala for a c-cionn for brú Abhann Móire ionnus

p.1126

gur bhó conair shodhaing shoimtheachta dia shluagh trésna feadhaibh h-isin. Ro forchongradh lais for a shlóghaibh cesaigh droichet comhdhaingen do dhénamh tarsan abhainn co riachtatar a shlóighdhiorma etir troicchtech & marcach dar an sruth anonn i n-a n-iomlaine gan bádhadh eich na duine dibh. Ro leiccset an droichet frisan sruth co na baí aga m-biodhbhadhaibh acht a f-fairccsin uatha don leith araill, & tainicc Ó Domhnaill dia tigh iaramh iar m-buaidh & coscar.

M1483.6 Jump to heading ¶

Slóiccheadh ele la h-Ua n-Domhnaill ar **Sean mac Pilip

Még Uidhir** co t-taratt creacha & airccthe iomdha lais. Creach

eile ar n-a mharach do denamh lá Domhnall Ua Neill ar in

Sean c-cédna.

M1483.7 Jump to heading ¶

Maidhm lá h-**Art mac Cuinn mic an Chalbhaigh Uí

Concobhair** ar Chonn mac Airt mic Cuint Uí Mhaoileachlainn

dú inar marbhadh dá mhac **Ruaidhri Charraigh Uí

Chearbhaill** co sochaidhibh ele amaille friu.

M1483.8 Jump to heading ¶

**Ua Cianáin, .i. Ruaidhri ollamh Mheg Uidhir

le senchus**, & **Concobhar Ócc Mac Flannchadha .i. ollamh

Tuadhmumhan** saoi dersccaighthe i n-eiccsi & h-i filidheacht d'écc,

& Aedh Mac Flannchadha i n-a ionad.

M1483.9 Jump to heading ¶

**Concobhar mac an Breithemhan adhbhar ollamhan **Muintire

Maol Ruain**** d'écc iar t-treablaitt fhoda.

M1483.10 Jump to heading ¶

An cuicceadh Eduard do riogadh ós Saxaibh 9. April. Da

mí, & ocht lá décc ro baí h-i righe.

M1483.11 Jump to heading ¶

Antres Risderd do rioghadh ós Saxaibh 22.

Iun.

p.1128

Annal M1484.

M1484.0 Jump to heading ¶

AOIS CRIOST, 1484.

Aoís Criost, Mile, ceithre céd,

ochtmoghat, a cethair.

M1484.1 Jump to heading ¶

Nioclás Uasdun, Epscop Doire d'écc.

M1484.2 Jump to heading ¶

**Seaan Ua Faircheallaigh canánach do muintir **Droma

Lethain****, & Brian Ua Fairceallaigh, saccart do thionnsccain cloch angcoire do dhénamh ag teampoll mhór Droma Leathain d'écc.

M1484.3 Jump to heading ¶

Niall mac an Comharba Mhég Mathghamhna d'écc occ toidhecht on Róimh.

M1484.4 Jump to heading ¶

**Rémann Mag Mathgamhna tighearna

Oirghiall** d'écc i n-a braighdenus i n-**Droichet

Átha**.

M1484.5 Jump to heading ¶

**Sémus mac Remainn Tirial ticcherna

Fer t-Tulach** d'écc.

M1484.6 Jump to heading ¶

**Donnchadh Ua Ceallaigh tanaisi

Ua Maine** d'écc iar t-trebhlaid fhoda.

M1484.7 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Uí Chonchobhair Fhailge **Murchadh mac Cathaoír mic

Cuinn mic an Chalbhaigh** do mharbhadh d'urchor saighde lá

cloinn Emainn Dairsidhigh h-i c-Crich na c-Cédach.

M1484.8 Jump to heading ¶

Tadhcc mac Uilliam mic Aodha mic Briain Uí Cheallaigh do

mharbhadh lá Brian Ua c-Ceallaigh lá a dearbrathair

fein, & lá h-Uilliam Ua Muireadhaigh a dearbh-comhalta

fein & a c-crochadh-sidhe lá h-Ua c-Ceallaigh i n-a c-ciontaibh.

M1484.9 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Briain mic Briain Ballaigh Uí Conchobhair do

marbadh lá sliocht Taidhg Uí Concobhair.

M1484.10 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall Mac Gormáin d'aos gradha Uí Bhriain,

fer tighe aoídheadh coitchinn & fer ro ba saidhbhre i n-Erinn a m-beótlus d'écc.

M1484.11 Jump to heading ¶

Aedh mac Briain Uí Briain & a bhen **Sadhbh inghean

Taidhg Uí Concobhair** d'écc.

p.1130

M1484.12 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri Ócc mac Ruaidhri Buidhe Uí Ainlighi d'écc.

M1484.13 Jump to heading ¶

Maoílechlainn mac Concobhair Uí Gairmledhaigh,

& Concobhar a dearbhrathair do mharbhadh lá cloinn **Eoghain mic

Néill Uí Dhomhnaill**.

M1484.14 Jump to heading ¶

**Brian Ruadh mac Cathail mic Eoghain mic Seain Uí

Raighilligh** d'écc.

M1484.15 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór etir Ua Neill .i. Conn mac Enri, & **Ua Domnaill

.i. Aodh Ruadh**, & dioghbala móra do denamh etorra.

M1484.16 Jump to heading ¶

**Giolla Patraicc mhac Még Uidhir (Emann mac Tomais

Óicc**) do mharbhadh a f-fiull lá

a cuiccer dearbhrathar (Donn,

Seaan, Emann, Art Carrach, & Aodh)

ag altoir tempaill Achaidh Urchair conidh tremid-sidhe do-gairedh

dá **Mag Uidhir .i. Sean mac Pilip mic Tomáis

Móir Még Uidhir** & Tomás mac Tomais Oicc mic Tomáis Mhóir. Seaan do dhol ar sloiccheadh ar cloinn Donnchaidh mic Tomais Meg Uidhir (Pilip & Feilim).

Giolla Pattraicc mac Tomáis mic Donnchaidh, & mac **Feilim mic

Donnchaidh Meg Uidhir** do mharbhadh lais co n-druing oile amaille friú. Mac Giolla Ruaidh, .i. Brian mac Domhnaill, da mac **Mec Domhnaill Cloinne

Ceallaigh** (Corbmac, & Art) & sochaide ele do gabhail. Bá dia h-Aoíne do shonnradh an 13 Calainn Septembris do-rónadh indsin, & Mág Uidhir Sean

do shoadh an lá-sin co m-buaidh & co n-edail.

M1484.17 Jump to heading ¶

Flaithbertach mac Tomáis mic Pilip Meg Uidhir do

mharbadh lá Tomás Ócc mac Tomais Óicc mic Tomais Mhóir d'erchor do ghae h-i b-Port Airidh Brosccaigh.

M1484.18 Jump to heading ¶

Maidhm Móna Ladhraighe lá cloinn Emainn Mheg Uidhir

ar cloinn Briain mic Pilip Mheg Uidhir dú in ro marbhadh tri

meic Briain, Cathal, Cu Chonnacht, & Emann,

& in ro marbhadh bheós Aedh mac Airt mic Eoghain Uí Néill,

Eoghan mac Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Pilip na Tuaighe Még Uidhir co

n-a mac Toirrdhealbhach, Remann mac Gillibert mic Corbmaic Uí Fhlannaccain co sochaidhibh oile, & inar gabhadh dna, **Pilip mac

Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Pilip Meg Uidhir** & Pilip mac Briain mic Pilip Még Uidhir & Giolla Patraicc mac Cathail Óicc mic Magnusa Még Uidhir,et cetera. Fiche do

dhaoinibh do marbhadh & deichnebhar do gabhadh ann.

p.1132

Annal M1485.

M1485.0 Jump to heading ¶

AOIS CRIOST, 1485.

Aoís Criost, Mile, ceithre chéd,

ochtmogat, a cúicc.

M1485.1 Jump to heading ¶

**Niocól Ua Grada comharba

Tuama Gréine** fer

dercach daghoinigh & an dara fear décc baoí saor i Luimneach d'écc.

M1485.2 Jump to heading ¶

**Donnchadh Mág Coilidh airchinneach

Beraicch** fer tighe aoidheadh coitchinn d'écc.

M1485.3 Jump to heading ¶

**Eoghan Caoch (.i. O Concobhair Donn) mac Feidhlimidh Uí

Concobhair** fear aghmar ionnsaightheach d'écc iar t-trebhlaid

fhoda & tighearna do ghairm i n-a ionad d'Aodh mac Aodha Uí Concobhair.

M1485.4 Jump to heading ¶

**Uilleag a Burc tighearna

Cloinne Riocaird oigre iarla Uladh**,

feicheamh coitchend d'eiccsibh Ereann d'écc, & a mac do gabhail a ionaid, .i. Uillecc ele. Sluaiccheadh lasan mac-sin for Machaire Chonnacht & h-i t-Tír Maine dia ro loiscc & dia ro mhill arbhanna & bailte, & dia ro loiscc & dia ro bris caislen Tuillsge & carcair.

M1485.5 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri mac Briain Ballaigh Uí Concobhair do marbhadh

lá sliocht Taidhg Uí Chonchobhair.

M1485.6 Jump to heading ¶

Sile inghen Mec Siurtáin ben **Ricaird

a Burc** baincheann ban Connacht d'écc.

M1485.7 Jump to heading ¶

**Aodh Ócc mac Aodha Buidhe mic Briain Ballaigh Uí

Neill tighearna Triain Congail** do dhol ar

creich i l-Leith Cathail & Goill do breith fair, & a mharbhadh d'aen erchor do ghae.

M1485.8 Jump to heading ¶

O Suillebhán Beirre Domhnall, O Concobair Corc Mo Dhruadh, &

O Concobhair Ciarraighe & a bhen d'écc.

M1485.9 Jump to heading ¶

O Baoighill Toirrdhealbhach do chor a thighernais de, & a mhac Niall do gabháil a ionaidh.

M1485.10 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór eitir Cenel c-Conaill,

& Eoghain. Clann Airt Uí Neill (.i. Niall co n-a braithribh)

do leith Uí Domhnaill. Clann Neachtain Uí Domhnaill (Eigneacan co n-a

braithribh) do leith Ui Neill. O Domhnaill do dol sluagh i

Muintir Luinigh

p.1134

uair as ann ro baí caoraighecht & muintir slechta Neachtain.

Baí Ó Neill, .i. Conn h-i f-foslongport a

Muintir Luinigh & sliocht Neachtain amaille fris acc

imdíten a tíre, & a muintire. Ar a aí ní ro fhéch Ó Domhnaill dóibh co n-dearna

creacha troma & airccthe aidhble. Ro ghabh lá taobh fhoslongpuirt Uí Neill, &

sleachta Neachtain, & tucc na creacha leis dia thír uatha gan dioghbhail do denamh dhó 'n-a t-timchell.

M1485.11 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh Ócc mac Aodha Ruaidh mic Rudhraighe mic Ardghail Még Mathghamhna do oirdneadh i n-a tighearna

for Oirghiallaibh.

M1485.12 Jump to heading ¶

Baile Chon Uladh mic Aedha Uí Néill do losccadh

lá Brian na Coilleadh mac Eoghain Uí Neill. Ferann & baile an Briain cédna do losccadh ar a bharach i n-a dhioghail lá Coin Uladh & la cloinn Remainn mic Rudhraighe Meg Mathghamna (Glaisne & Brian) & lá mac Mhég Mhathghamhna Óig, .i. Giolla Pattraicc.

M1485.13 Jump to heading ¶

Sliocht Mhaol Mhórdha an Mhullaigh do ionnarbadh asa

n-duthaigh, & clann Glaisne Uí Raghallaigh do shuidhiughadh a t-tíre dia n-eis, & do dhenamh caislein innte. Iatt-somh do tharraing iarla Chille Dara (Gearóid mac Tomais) ar chloinn Glaisne,

& cúicc buailte décc bó do bhuain dibh i c-creich, & Giolla Íosa mac Glaisne

do gabhail don chur-sin.

M1485.14 Jump to heading ¶

Feidhlimidh mac Glaisne mic Conchobhair Uí Raghallaigh d'écc don phláigh.

M1485.15 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Raghallaigh, .i. Toirrdhealbhach mac Seain mic Eoghain do

dhol i t-Teallach Eachdhach, & baile Még Samradháin .i. Feilim, & baile Donnchaidh a dearbrathar do losccadh leis. Mag Samhradháin co n-a braithribh do dhol a t-toraighecht an t-sluagh ar a barach & sé fir decc ettir gabhail & marbhadh & dá ched each do bhuain don t-sluagh.

M1485.16 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Domhnaill (.i. Colla) consapal Gallocclach Uí Neill d'écc.

M1485.17 Jump to heading ¶

Remann mac Glaisne mic Remainn Meg Mathghamna do dhol ar

Galldacht Machaire Airghiall, & mac don Tau, .i. Seon do marbhadh

leis. Conn mac Maghnusa Uí Chondalaigh, **Mac Corbmaic

Uí Chondalaigh**, & mac mec Ardgail do marbhadh uadha-somh, & ós cenn fhichit

each do bhuain de fein & dá mhuintir. **Cathaoir

p.1136

mac Iriail mic Pilip** & **Eoghan mac Semais mic Eochadha Móir

Még Mathghamhna** do ghabhail, & Eoghan, d'eludh iar

sin.

M1485.18 Jump to heading ¶

**Art an Bhoccáin mac Uí Chonchobhair Fhailghe (.i.

Conn)** do mharbhadh lá a dherbrathair **Cathaoir mac Cuinn

mic an Chalbhaigh** d'aen erchor gae.

M1485.19 Jump to heading ¶

Clann ócc Emainn Meg Uidhir (Aodh, Art, & Giolla Íosa)

& clann Toirrdhealbhaigh Meg Uidhir (Tadhg, Pilip, & an Giolla Dubh) do

dhenamh creiche ar **Domhnall mac Giolla Pattraicc mic Emainn

Mhégh Uidhir**. Domhnall féin do mharbhadh a t-toraighecht

na creiche lá Maoilechlainn Mac Geibheannaigh & an **Maol

Seachlainn** cedna do marbhadh fó cedóir ar an lathair-sin.

M1485.20 Jump to heading ¶

Mag Uidhir .i. Sean do dhenamh creche h-i Miodhbolcc ar cloinn Donnchaidh mic Aodha Meg Uidhir, & ar cloinn Mhég Ualgaircc fa dhó i n-aoin t-seachtmhain.

M1485.21 Jump to heading ¶

Giolla Pattraicc Ua h-Uiccinn, mac Briain, mic Maoilechlainn,

fer tighe aoidhedh coitchinn do thrénaibh & do truaghaibh d'écc.

M1485.22 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Cuirnín Athairne d'écc.

M1485.23 Jump to heading ¶

An sechtmadh King Henry do rioghadh os Saxaibh, 22. August.

p.1138

Annal M1486. AOIS CRIOST, 1486.

M1486.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aois Criost, mile, ceithre chéd, ochtmoghat, a

sé.

M1486.1 Jump to heading ¶

Mainistir (.i. **Cill

Chuilind**) Brathar Mionúr de Obseruantia

do thionnsgnadh ar brú abhann Life la

**Rolont mac Sir Eduard

Iustas**.

M1486.2 Jump to heading ¶

Prioir Maothla Fergal mac Roiberd Mhég Ragnaill d'écc.

M1486.3 Jump to heading ¶

**Pilip mac an Chomharba (.i. Semus mac Rudhraighe mic

Ardgail) Meg Mathghamhna**, cananach coradh h-i c-Clochar comarba Cluana h-Eoais, persun Dartraighe, et cetera d'

écc.

M1486.4 Jump to heading ¶

Caibidil coithcenn an chúiccidh idus Iulii i

n-Droichet Atha ag **airdespucc Arda Macha, .i. Octauianus

Italicus** acc epscopaiph & acc cleircibh tuaiscirt Ereann

uile.

M1486.5 Jump to heading ¶

**Ruaidhri mac Diarmada (.i. mac

Ruaidhri Chaoich)

tighearna Moighe Luircc, Airticch,

& Tíre Tuathail** d'écc do ghalar aithgherr h-i t-tempall Locha na n-Gasan i c-Cloinn Cathail Mic Muireadhaigh,

& Concobhar mac Corbmaic mic Tomaltaigh an Einigh d'oirdneadh i n-a ionadh.

M1486.6 Jump to heading ¶

Cu Mara Mac Con Mara do mharbhadh go h-aitheasach la cloinn

Donnchaidh Mec Con Mara.

M1486.7 Jump to heading ¶

**Tadhcc mac Cathail Óicc Meg Raghnaill

lán-taoíseach Muintire h-Eolais** saoi dearsccaighthe ar

eineach & ar eangnamh d'ecc iar m-buaidh o dheamhan & ó

dhomhan, & a adhnacal h-i f-Fiodhnach.

M1486.8 Jump to heading ¶

**Tadhcc Ua Maoíl Mhiadhaigh adhbar taoisigh

Mhuintire Cerbhalláin** do mharbhadh lá

cloinn Maoileachlainn Meg Raghnaill, & lá cloinn Mhaol Ruanaidh Meg Raghnaill.

M1486.9 Jump to heading ¶

Eoghan mac Ír do ghabhail lá cloinn **Maol Ruanaidh Meg

Raghnaill**, & clann Taidhcc Uí Mhaoíl Mhiadhaigh do

mharbhadh, & mac Uilliam Mic Maghnusa co sochaidhibh oile.

p.1140

M1486.10 Jump to heading ¶

Maol Seachlainn & Ruaidhri dá mac Mec Donnchaidh Thire h-Oilealla, .i. Tadhg mac Briain (Soidheach diongmhala do toisighecht **Ua

n-Oilealla** gach aon diobh) do marbhadh la cloinn Domhnaill Caim & la

cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Donnchaidh.

M1486.11 Jump to heading ¶

Sluaiccheadh adhbal mhor lá h-Ua n-Domhnaill i c-Connactaibh

& lá Mac Uilliam Cloinne Riocaird i n-a aghaidh,

& iar n-dol h-i c-cenn aroile dhóibh, do-ronsat síth &

comhaonta. Feidhlimidh Fionn Ua Conchobhair do dhol h-i c-cenn

na sluagh-sin, & a dhol h-i laimh Uí Domhnaill tar cenn a

thuath & a thaoiseach. Sídh Shíl Muiredhaigh do

denamh don cur-sin, & Mac Feidhlimidh Fhinn do ghabhail as féin

d'Ua n-Domhnaill & a breith leis i t-Tír Conaill

tré comhairle Meic Uilliam Cloinde Riocaird.

M1486.12 Jump to heading ¶

Breasmaidhm la muintir Meg Raghnaill h-i Moin Lescc for cloinn

Uí Ruairc & for sliocht Cathail Ruaidh in ro marbhadh

Maoíleclainn Ócc mac Maoílechlainn Mec Caba

fer a aoísi fein do ba mó ainm le gallócclachus h-i Leth Cuinn.

M1486.13 Jump to heading ¶

Clann t-Seain mic an Phriora do chreachadh, & mac dibh

fein (.i. Giolla Criost) do mharbhad la sliocht **Maoilechlainn

Mhég Raghnaill**.

M1486.14 Jump to heading ¶

Neidhe Ua Maoíl Chonaire cend doichill Ereann d'écc.

As é tucc na mionna buadha co na tiubhradh im & arán a n-aoinfheacht d'aoidhedhaibh co bráth.

M1486.15 Jump to heading ¶

Slóiccheadh lá h-Ua n-Domhnaill do dhol i t-Tír Amalgaidh.

Mac Uilliam Iochtarach do theacht i n-a aghaidh.

Ro fighedh iomairecc etorra in ro marbhadh tuilleadh ar

ched do muintir Mec Uilliam & in ro gabhadh Sean Mac Siurtáin & Uillecc mac Risdeird (.i. mac Tomais) a Burc co sochaidhibh oile.

M1486.16 Jump to heading ¶

Seaan mac an Priora Meg Raghnaill d'écc.

M1486.17 Jump to heading ¶

An Barrach Mór (Sean), rogha gall-macaemh Ereann do

mharbhadh lá Nodlacc lá **Donnchadh Ócc Mhacc

Cárthaigh tighearna Ealla** iar n-dol ar creich fair.

M1486.18 Jump to heading ¶

Gearóid mac iarla Deasmumhan d'écc.

p.1142

M1486.19 Jump to heading ¶

Feidhlimidh Buidhe mac Cairpre Uí Conchobhair, **Uaitne mac

Seain Carraigh Mec Branáin**, **Donnchadh mac Corbmaic mec

Matha** & Aodh mac Ruaidhri Dhuibh mec Matha do mharbhadh lá

cloinn Maoilechlainn Még Raghnaill.

M1486.20 Jump to heading ¶

Tadg Caoch mac Uilliam Uí Cheallaigh an dara tighearna baoí for Uibh Maine d'écc

i n-aibíd an Treas Uird.

M1486.21 Jump to heading ¶

Sile inghen Aodha mic Uilliam Uí Ceallaigh ben Uí Mhadadháin d'écc.

M1486.22 Jump to heading ¶

Lochlainn mac an Giolla Claoín Uí Ainlighi d'écc.

M1486.23 Jump to heading ¶

Tadg mac Aodha mic Briain Uí Birn, & **Maoíleachlainn

mac Diarmada Mhég Raghnaill** d'écc.

M1486.24 Jump to heading ¶

**Eocchan mac Lochlainn Uí Ruairc saoileachtain

tighearna na Breifne** d'écc.

M1486.25 Jump to heading ¶

**Semus mac Mec Risdeird Buitilér fear ionait iarla

Urmumhan** d'écc.

M1486.26 Jump to heading ¶

Bresal & Diarmaid da mac Murchaidh Uí Madadháin

do mharbhadh i meabhail la Cobhthach Ua Madadháin lá a n-dearbrathair féin.

M1486.27 Jump to heading ¶

**Raghnailt inghen t-Seaain Mec Con Mara ben

**Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Taidhg Uí Bhriain tighearna

Tuadhmhumhan Airtheraigh**** d'écc.

M1486.28 Jump to heading ¶

**Giolla na Naomh mac Domhnaill mic Muirceartaigh Mhidhigh

tighearna Caladh na h-Angaile**

d'écc iar c-cian aoís.

M1486.29 Jump to heading ¶

Tadhg mac Aodhagain ollamh Muintire h-Angaile do mharbhadh go grainemhail lá sliocht Íriail Uí Feargail.

M1486.30 Jump to heading ¶

Flann mac Floinn Uí Domnalláin d'ecc.

M1486.31 Jump to heading ¶

**Brian mac Rudhraighe mic Ardgail Meg Mathgamhna

tighearna Dartraighe** do mharbhadh lá

Gallaibh Machaire Airghiall.

M1486.32 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall Ócc mac Mec Artain saoí n-einigh d'écc.

p.1144

M1486.33 Jump to heading ¶

**Sean Buidhe mac Eoghain mic Néill Óicc

Uí Néill** d'ecc.

M1486.34 Jump to heading ¶

Donnchadh mac Tomais mic Ferghail Mecc Samhradhain d'écc.

M1486.35 Jump to heading ¶

Ocht m-baile fhichet do

Ghalldacht Machaire Airghiall do

losccadh lá **Mag Mathghamhna, Aodh Ócc mac Aodha Ruaidh

mic Rudhraighe**.

M1486.36 Jump to heading ¶

O Neill, .i. Conn mac Enrí do dhol sluagh ria Samhain ar

Machaire Airghiall loisccthi & millte móra do denamh

lais.

M1486.37 Jump to heading ¶

Creach mhór lá Brian mac Emainn mic Rudhraighe Meg Mhathgamna ar

Emann mac Tomáis Óicc, & ar a chloinn

i c-Cúil na n-Oirer, & **Emann Ócc

mac Emainn** do mharbhadh leo i n-Doire Cenainn.

M1486.38 Jump to heading ¶

**Emann mac Tomáis Ghreandaigh mic Duinn mic Pilip na Tuaighe

Meg Uidhir** d'écc, & a dearbhrathair ele **Eoghan mac Tomais

Greandaigh**, Magnus mac Maoile Duin, & **Rudhraighe mac Concobair mic

Duinn Meg Uidir** do mharbhadh ar Baile an Oireacht

la Féilim mac Donnchaidh Még Uidir ar greis oidhche.

**Caitilin inghen **Uí Feargail (Domhnall Buidhe mac

Domhnaill mic Seain)** ben **Mec Maghnusa Meg Uidhir .i.

Cathal Ócc mac Catail Mhóir**** d'écc.

M1486.39 Jump to heading ¶

Art Ruadh mac Giolla Patraicc mic Emainn Meg Uidhir do mharbhadh

d'urchor soighde lá cloinn Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Pilip Meg Uidhir.

M1486.40 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Néill mic Aodha mic Eoghain Uí Neill d'écc.

M1486.41 Jump to heading ¶

Emann Ócc mac Emainn mic Con Uladh Uí Néill &

Corbmac mac Airt Carraigh mic Maoileachlainn Uí Neill d'écc.

M1486.42 Jump to heading ¶

Clann Meg Uidhir (Emann), .i. Aodh & Art Carrach d'fuaslaccadh, &

a n-athair do léiccen a tighearnais de an lá

cédna docom t-Seain mic Pilip Meg Uidhir.

M1486.43 Jump to heading ¶

Donn Mag Uidhir mac Emainn mic Tomais Óig do mharbhadh a

f-fiull h-i n-dorus Reilcce Achaidh Urchair lé cloinn

Tomáis Oig Meg Uidhir, .i. Tomás, Conchobhar,

& Ruaidhri & lá cloind Flaithbhertaigh mic Tomais Óig,

Giolla Pataicc, Cu Connacht, & Briain Crosach.

p.1146

Annal M1487. AOIS CRIOST, 1487.

M1487.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aoís Criost, míle, cethre ched,

ochtmhoccat, a secht.

M1487.1 Jump to heading ¶

**Maoilechlainn mac Murchaidh Uí Fhlannaccáin decanach

Oile Finn** d'écc, & Tomas Ua h-Eidigein do

ghabhail a ionaid.

M1487.2 Jump to heading ¶

Tadhg mac Briain mic Amlaoíbh Meg Uidhir ro bhaí 'na

pearsún i m-Bothaibh ar tos & 'na

biocaire h-i c-Cill Laissre d'ecc.

M1487.3 Jump to heading ¶

Brian Ua Corcrain biocair Claoin Innsi & **Denis mac Giolla Coisccle airchinneach,

& biocaire Airidh Brosca** d'écc.

M1487.4 Jump to heading ¶

**O Maoileachlainn, .i. Laigneach mac Cuirc tighearna

Cloinne Colmain** do mharbhadh le Conn mac Airt mic Cuinn mic Corbmaic Ballaigh Uí Mhaoileachlainn.

M1487.5 Jump to heading ¶

O Raghallaigh, .i. Toirrdhealbhach mac Seain mic Eoghain d'écc

do bhedhcc i n-a chaislén féin h-i t-Tulaigh Mongáin an céd

lá do mhí September & Ó Raghallaigh do gairm da mhac i n-a ionad .i. Sean.

M1487.6 Jump to heading ¶

**Brian mac Briain Bhallaigh mic Aodha mic Feilim Uí

Concobhair** soidheach diongmhala do righe Connacht d'écc.

M1487.7 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Ruaidhri mic Briain Uí Conchobhair d'écc.

M1487.8 Jump to heading ¶

Siodhraidh Ua Maol Conaire ollamh Shil Muireadhaigh

cenn aibhe & aitis fear n-Ereann d'écc & da chenn fhine i

n-a ionad .i. Domhnall & Maol Conaire mac Torna.

M1487.9 Jump to heading ¶

Muirghes mac Lochlainn Ui Mhaoil Conaire oide a

cheirde féin d'écc i t-Tír Conuill iar t-treablait fhoda, & iar m-buaidh n-aithricche & a adhnacal i n-Dun na n-Gall.

M1487.10 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall Ua Dubhaccáin, & a bhen inghen

Uí Mhaoíl Conaire d'écc.

Ua Maoil Fhalaidh drumchli eccna Ua Maine d'écc.

Iarla Desmumhan do mharbhadh

lá a muintir féin a meabhail h-i Ráith Gaola tre chomhairle

Sheain a dearbrathar féin.Sean dna & lucht an mharbhtha archena d'ionnarbadh

la Muiris mac an Iarla.

**Uilliam mac Aodha mic Briain Uí Cheallaigh tighearna

Ua Maine** do ghabhail lá a bhraithribh feisin a meabail & a

écc i n-a geimhlibh, & dá tighearna i n-a ionadh, .i. **Maoileachlainn mac Aedha mic

Briain** & Donnchadh mac Bresail Uí Cheallaigh.

Aodh mac Donnchaidh Ui Cheallaigh do mharbhadh lá

M1487.17 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall Ua Concobhair do dhol ar ionnsaighidh for

Leitir mic Pilip, & briseadh dóibh ar dhreim dá mhuintir gur

marbhait ann da mac Domhnaill mic Briain Mec Donnchaidh & móran dá n-uaislibh & da muintir archena.

M1487.18 Jump to heading ¶

**Brian Ruadh, mac Tighearnáin, mic Taidhg mic Tighearnain

Uí Ruairc tanaise Breifne** do mharbhadh d'urchor do saighit la mac **Uí Ruairc, Eoghan mac Feilim mic Donnchaidh mic

Tighearnáin Óicc**. Ua Domhnaill .i. Aodh Ruadh do dhol

trésan marbhadh-sin isin m-Breifne, & suidhe dho a

f-foslongport fá bhaile

Uí Ruairc .i. Caislén an Cairthe, & a ghabhail lais

& triúr do mhuintir Uí Ruairc do mharbhadh & **Brian mac

Cathail mic Tighearnain Uí Ruairc** do mharbhadh lá

Gofraidh mac Aedha Gallda Uí Domhnaill d'urchor peléir. An caislen do bhriseadh lá h-**Ua

p.1150

n-Domhnaill** iar sin, & O Ruairc Feilim d'ionnarbadh as a dhuthaigh h-i f-Fearaibh Manach lá h-Ua n-Domnaill. Ua Domhnaill doridhisi

do léigean Uí Ruairc i n-a dhuthaigh, & sidh do dhenamh

eitir feraibh Breifne, & a thabhairt ar in tír an

caislén do aithdenamh.

M1487.19 Jump to heading ¶

Maol Ruanaidh mac Taidhcc Mec Diarmada do gabhail a meabail ar

Oilén na Trinóide la **Tomaltach mac Ruaidhri Mec

Diarmada**, & mac Briain Mec Diarmada do mharbhadh ann.

M1487.20 Jump to heading ¶

Alastrann mac Colla mic Toirrdhealbhaigh, & dream do maithibh a ghallócclach do mharbhadh araon ris lá cloinn **Ruaidhri

mec Diarmada**.

M1487.21 Jump to heading ¶

Sean Mac an Airchinnigh cenn a fhine féin fear

tighe aoidhedh coitcinn, & airchindeach Padraicc

i n-Ail Finn d'écc.

M1487.22 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Pilip Ruaidh Mec Con Mara fer crodha coccthach d'écc.

M1487.23 Jump to heading ¶

**Sean Dabh Mac Goisdelbhaigh tighearna

Slebe Lugha** d'écc, & dá tighearna i n-a ionad,

.i. Uilliam mac Emainn an Machaire, a dherbrathair fén &

Siúrtan mac Pilip Mec Goisdelbhaigh.

M1487.24 Jump to heading ¶

**Sean mac Conchobhair Mec Aedaccain

ollamh

Cloinne Riocaird**, & Aodh mac Briain mic Feargail Ruaidh Uí Uiccinn d'écc.

M1487.25 Jump to heading ¶

Cathaoír Mág Cochláin do marbhadh h-i f-fioll

lá mac a dherbhrathar Fínghin Ruadh.

M1487.26 Jump to heading ¶

Emann mac Riocaird a Burc do gabhail a meabhail lá

Bairédachaibh, & a thabhach go h-áitheasach dia bhraithribh féin.

M1487.27 Jump to heading ¶

Slóigheadh lá h-Ua n-Domhnaill i m-**Breifne **Uí

Ruairc****. Bá h-é fochann an t-slóighidh-sin, **O Ruairc Feilim mac

Donnchaidh mic Tighearnáin**, & a bhaile do ghabhail a

p.1152

f-fiull lá a bhraithribh féin, & iar n-dol **Uí

Dhomhnaill** don Breifne foslongport

do dhenamh dho imon m-baile, .i.Caislén an Chairthe,

& an baile do ghabhail leis fo dheoidh iar m-beith athaidh na timcheall, & **Tighearnan

Dubh mac Donnchaidh mic Tighearnain Óicc**

do mharbhadh lá h-Ua n-Domnaill don chur-sin, & O Ruairc Feilim

d'fháccbháil d'Ua Dhomhnaill h-i c-Caislén in Chairthe iar síodhucchadh

fear m-Breifne fria 'roile. O Ruairc do gherradh ciosa cosanta d'Ua Dhomhnaill isin m-Breifne & d'fior a ionaid i n-a dhiaidh.

M1487.28 Jump to heading ¶

**Tighearnán Ócc O Ruairc tanaisi

Breifne** do mharbhadh lá cloinn **Maol Ruanaigh

Meg Raghnaill**, & lá cloinn **Ruaidhri

Mec Diarmada** i n-Ucht na n-Engadh.

M1487.29 Jump to heading ¶

Slóicceadh lá h-Aodh Ruadh Ua n-Domhnaill h-i Maigh Luircc dia ro mhill arbhanda & dia ro loiscc bailte caisléin iomdha. Ro loiscc & ro bris caislén cloinne

Ruaidhri Mec Diarmada, .i. Baile na h-Uamha.

O Domhnaill fein co n-diorma dia shluagh do asccnamh co h-inchleithe isin oidhche as a longport co n-dearna creacha móra i n-Doire Chua. **Feidhlimid Fionn Ua Concobhair (.i. mac Taidcc mic

Toirrdhealbhaigh Ruaidh**) do dhol h-i c-cenn Uí Dhomhnaill don chur-sin,

& síth shuthain do dhenamh dhó fris. **Ruaidhri an Doire mac Muirghesa mic Aodha

Mec Diarmata** baí h-i sochraide Uí Dhomhnaill ar an slóiccheadh-sin do shárucchadh

na Ceall Bhraighi Uallaighi, & édala móra do breith eiste, &

Ó Domhnaill do thabhairt óghaisicc do shagartaibh an tempaill ro sáraiccheadh ann.

M1487.30 Jump to heading ¶

Slóiccheadh la **Mac Uilliam Cloinne Riocaird (.i. Uilleacc

mac Uillicc an Fhiona**) i n-Uibh Maine dia ro briseadh lais

badhbhdhúin Atha Liacc Maonaccan, Arbhanna & bailte iomdha do milleadh dhó i n-Uibh Maine, & h-i Machaire Chonnacht.

p.1154

Rossa mac Feidhlimidh Fhinn do mharbhadh d'aon urcor saighde la

druing don t-sluagh. Clann Feilim Finn Ui Concobhair .i. Aodh,

Toirrdhealbhach, & Conchobhar, do dhol tarsa co

Baile Tobair Brighde. A losccadh & a argain dóibh.

**Diarmaitt mac Domhnaill mic Toirrdhealbhaigh Doill

Uí Conchobhair** do mharbhadh doibh .i. ag Ros Comain, h-i luircc an t-sluaigh. A lenmhain dóibh

asein h-i c-Cloinn Chonnmhaigh, & eich do bein don t-sluagh cedna. Ba for tharraing **Uí Conchobhair Duinn, .i. Aodh mac Aodha mic Toirrdhealbhaigh

Duinn**, do-ronadh an sluaiccheadh-sin. Sídh Sil Muiredhaigh do dhenamh dhoibh budhdéin iar n-diultadh a dénmha ar comairle a c-caratt.

M1487.31 Jump to heading ¶

Creacha meabla do denomh do Ruaidhri Ua Chonchobhair ar Felim Fhinn. Creacha anba i n-a dioghail-sidhe la Feilim f-Finn Ua c-Conchobhair for slicht Taidhg Óig.

M1487.32 Jump to heading ¶

Sidh Shil Muiredhaigh do naidhm doridhisi, & tighearnas sleachta Corbmaic Ui Birn & leth Baile an Cláir, &

cóicc baile Chinn Coradh do-chuid ronna **Toirrdhealbhaigh

Óicc**, do mhaithemh dá shliocht d'**Feidhlim Ua

Conchobhair**. Bladh do Chloinn Cathail Mic Muiredhaigh do

baí athaidh d'aimsir i l-laimh cloinne Maol Ruain do tabairt

d'Feidhlimidh Fhionn Ua c-Concobhair.

M1487.33 Jump to heading ¶

**Tighearnán Carrach mac Tighearnain mic Taidhg mic

Tighernain Uí Ruairc**, Feradhach mac Seain mic Toirrdhealbhaigh Még Uidhir, & **Domhnall mac Duinn mic Domnaill

mic Airt Még Uidir** do mharbhadh h-i Muintir Eolais lá cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Diarmata &

lá mac Mec Diarmada Ruaidh, &

Domhnall Bearnach Mac Samhradhain do mharbhadh don chur-sin.

M1487.34 Jump to heading ¶

O Domhnaill, .i. Aodh do dhol h-i Maigh Luircc isin f-foghmhar do shonnradh.

p.1156

Tighe iomdha & arbhanna do losccadh leis & Tempall Droma Conaille do losccadh an tan-sin lá Ferghal Carrach mac Domnaill mic Taidhcc Uí Ruairc gan cet d'Ua Dhomhnaill, & ó nach rucc Ó Domhnaill ar Fearghal Charrach do dhioghail an mhíghniomha-sin fair, do-rad mac Tighearnain na Buannaide do cléircibh an tempaill a n-gioll frisan losccadh-sin.

Annal M1488. AOIS CRIOST, 1488.

M1488.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aois Criost, Mile ceithre ced, ochtmoghat, a

h-ocht.

M1488.1 Jump to heading ¶

Ab Atha Truim d'écc.

Pláigh mhór for Machaire Chonnacht dia ro écc **Cathal mac Eidigein

biocair tempaill Pattraicc, & cananach coradh i n-Oil Finn**,

Aongus Ua Reachtadhain comharba Finnéin

h-i c-Cluain Cremha Diarmaid Mac Conchagaidh sagart toghaidhe, & an **Biocaire

Bodhar Ua Colla**.

p.1158

Feargail**, & **Corbmac mac Domhnaill Chananaigh

Uí Bhirn** d'écc dhi bheos.

M1488.5 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Ceallaigh (Maoilechlainn mac Aodha mic Briain) d'écc a c-cionn lethráithe iar n-gabhail tighearnais, & Conchobhar a bhrathair do ghabhail a ionaid.

Mag Aongasa, .i. Brian mac Airt d'écc, & a dearbhrathair (Aodh) d'oirdneadh i n-a ionadh.

O Flannaccain Tuaithe Ratha Toirrdhelbhach mac Giolla Iosa d'écc.

O Tuathail (Emann) do mharbhadh i f-fiull la cloinn **Taidhcc Uí

Broin**.

Diarmaid mac Seain Luircc mic Toirrdhealbhaigh an Fhíona Uí Dhomnaill d'écc.

Maoileachlainn d'écc, & Mag Raghnaill do denamh i n-a ionadh do **Mhaoilechlainn

mac Uilliam** don t-sliocht cedna.

O Neill Conn mac Enri, & Mag Uidhir Sean mac Pilip mic Tomais do dol go teagh Uí Domnaill & sidh charthanach cairdemhail do dhenamh d'Ua Neill & d'Ua n-Domnaill ré 'roile.

M1488.16 Jump to heading ¶

Domhnall mac Neill Uí Neill do mharbhadh h-i f-Fionntamhnach lá Rudhraighe mac Airt, & lá cloinn Néill mic Airt Uí Neill.

dhomhan & ó dhemhan.

M1488.22 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri mac Uí Concobhair Duinn d'écc.

M1488.23 Jump to heading ¶

Cú Uladh mac Seain Bhuidhe Uí Neill do mharbhadh lá h-Art mac Enrí mic Eoghain.

Eoghan mac Uí Ruairc, Feilim mac Donnchaidh mic Tighearnain Óicc mic Tigearnáin Mhóir do mharbhadh ar ossadh le h-Eoghan ele mac Uí Ruairc .i. mac Tighernain mic Taidhcc mic Tighearnain Mhóir.

M1488.26 Jump to heading ¶

**Eoghan mac Maol Morda Uí Ragallaigh tigearna **Mullaigh

Laoighill**** d'écc.

M1488.27 Jump to heading ¶

Donnchadh Dubshúileach Ua Conchobhair .i. Ua Conchobhair Ruadh, d'écc iar c-cian aoís & iar n-deighbethaidh, & Feidhlimidh Fionn Ua Conchobhair d'oirdneadh i n-a ionadh lá h-Ua n-Domhnaill, lá Mac Uilliam & la Mac n-Diarmada .i. Conchobhar feibh as diongmala ro

gaireadh tighearna d'aon roimhe ré h-athaidh & a bhrocc do chor fair do Mac Diarmata.

p.1162

M1488.28 Jump to heading ¶

Sidh do dhenamh d'Ua Domhnaill fri Mac Uilliam Búrc. Ua Conchobhair & Mac Diarmata h-i c-coraighecht & h-i slánaib etorra.

M1488.29 Jump to heading ¶

Forbhaisi lá h-Ua n-Domhnaill & lá Mac n-Diarmatta .i. Concobhar, ar Carraicc Locha Cé baí ag cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Diarmata. Arbhanna an tíre do mhilleadh & do caithemh dóibh. Ua Domnaill d'imtheacht iar f-feimdheadh dol fuirre. Foslongport Mec Diarmata do ghabháil dia gallocclachaibh féin iar n-a fhagbail for a c-comairce, & arthraige an locha uile do breith doibh for an Carraicc.

M1488.30 Jump to heading ¶

Uilliam mac Aodha Mec Branain taoiseach Corc Achlann d'écc i n-ocht Febru iar m-buaidh n-aithrighe & a adhnacal i

n-Oil Finn.

M1488.31 Jump to heading ¶

Sean Manntach fear urlamhais marbtha Iarla Desmumhan do bhasucchadh lá

Muiris mac an Iarla. Iarla do ghairm do Mhuiris mac an Iarla.

M1488.32 Jump to heading ¶

Lenab ionggnathach do gheinemhain i n-Ath Cliath i n-a m-bátar a fhiacla acca breith. Ro fhas méad adhbal ann iar na gheinemhain nách clos a commor h-i leanab ó aimsir na c-curadh.

M1488.33 Jump to heading ¶

Sidhe gaoíthe do dhol fo meithil mhóna baí i

t-Tuaim Mona, & duine dibh do mharbhadh, aighthe an

lochta oile do at, & cethrar ele do mharbhadh don gaoith cedna

M1488.34 Jump to heading ¶

Emann mac Riocaird a Burc rogha Gall-macaomh Connacht d'écc.

M1488.35 Jump to heading ¶

Sean Ócc Ua h-Eghra & a mac do mharbhadh h-i fiull lá cloinn Uí Eaghra, .i. Ruaidhri, & Aedh (clann a dearbrathar féin)

dia Domhnaigh do shonnradh i mainistir an Bend Fhoda.

p.1164

M1488.36 Jump to heading ¶

**Donnchadh mac Mathghamhna tighearna

Corca Baiscinn** do écc, & da mac Mathghamna i n-a ionat,

.i. Brian a mac féin & **Tadhg Ruadh mac

Toirrdhealbhaigh Mec Mathghamhna**.

M1488.37 Jump to heading ¶

Fergal Mac an Ruagaire d'écc. Baí an

Feargal-sin fiche bliadhan ag caitheamh a choda amail gach aon, & ní dheachaidh d'imthealccadh a chuirp frisan ré-sin.

M1488.38 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri Ua Concobhair .i. mac Feidlimidh, fear lé raibhe

suil na sochaidhe do gabhail comarbais a athar d'écc i m-**Baile Tobair

Brighde** i mí Auguist.

Creachsluaiccheadh lá h-Iarla Cille Dara

h-i c-Cenel Fhiachach Mic Neill dia ro

bhris Caislen Bile Ratha

for cloinn Muirceartaigh Meg Eochaccáin iar t-tabhairt ordanais chuicce.

M1488.40 Jump to heading ¶

Maoileachlainn mac Ruaidhri Mec Diarmada, & Muirges mac Aodha Mec Diarmatta d'écc.

M1488.41 Jump to heading ¶

Tadhg mac Aedha mic Toirrdhealbhaigh Uí Choncobhair ced rogha macaemh slechta Briain Luighnigh d'écc, aidhche Cascc do sonnradh.

M1488.42 Jump to heading ¶

**Diarmaid mac Taidhcc Uí Concobhair,

tanaisi-tighearna** a cheneoil, fear as mó ler thuit dia biodhbadhaibh dá laimh baí i n-Erinn i n-a aimsir d'ecc do ghalar fhuail iar t-treablait fhoda.

M1488.43 Jump to heading ¶

Concobhar mac Dubthaigh Uí Dhuibhgeannáin do bhadhadh ar Loch Bradain a Muintir Eolais.

M1488.44 Jump to heading ¶

Maol Conaire mac Torna Uí Maol Conaire d'ecc do ghalar

aithghearr h-i c-Cluain na h-Oidche.

M1488.45 Jump to heading ¶

**Maol Maire mac Taidhcc Óicc

Uí Uiccinn oide

Ereann le dán**, & Mac an Baird Oirghiall d'ecc.

Annal M1489. AOIS CRIOST, 1489.

M1489.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aois Criost, Mile, ceithre ched, ochtmoghat, a

naoí.

M1489.1 Jump to heading ¶

**Nioclas Ua Cathasaigh biocaire

Daimhinsi for Loch Eirne** & Tadhcc Ua Maithgen, manach do manchaibh na Buille d'écc.

M1489.2 Jump to heading ¶

O Neill, .i. Enri mac Eoghain mic Neill Óicc, Mac Giolla Pattraic Seffraidh tighearna Osraighe,

Ua Cearbhaill Sean tigherna Éle, O Baigill Toirrdhealbhach, Maghnas mac Aodha Ruaidh mic Rudhraighe Mhég Mathghamna, & Concobar mac Glaisne Ui Ragallaigh d'écc.

M1489.3 Jump to heading ¶

Pláigh mhór isin m-bliadhain-si dia ro éccsat ile. Baí da h-aidble co na fagbhaidís daoíne a n-adhnacal

seachnón Ereann.

M1489.4 Jump to heading ¶

**Remann mac Uaithne mic Feargail mic Tomais mic Mathghamhna mic

Giolla Iosa Ruaidh Uí Raghallaigh** d'écc dhi.

M1489.5 Jump to heading ¶

**Feidhlimidh Ócc mac Feidhlimidh mic Feargail mic

Tomáis mic Mathghamhna mic Giolla Iosa Ruaidh Ui Raghallaigh**, **Domhnall mac Torna Uí Maol

Conaire adbhar ollamhan **Sil

Muiredhaigh****, Domhnall Cananach mac Taidhcc Uí Bhirn, Corbmac Ua Conalladh ceann

Gallocclach culcoimeda Uí Conchobhair, an **Inghean Dubh inghen Uí Chonchobhair, .i.

Donnchadh Dubhshuileach**, **Aodh Buidhe & Domnall Caoch dá mac

Uí Ainlighi**, Rúdhraighe Glas mac Ruaidhri mic Aodha, **Mac

Donnchaidh Riabhaigh, .i. Aodh**, & Fionnghuala inghen Mec Diarmata Ruaidh d'écc don plaigh uile.

M1489.6 Jump to heading ¶

Maoileachlainn mac Muirceartaigh mic Eoghain Uí Neill do marbhadh la cloinn Briain na Coilleadh mic Eoghain Uí Neill.

M1489.7 Jump to heading ¶

Rudhraighe mac Dabhid Uí Mhórdha tanaisi Laigisi d'écc.

M1489.8 Jump to heading ¶

Ros mac Uaithne Uí Morda do marbhadh lá Cathaoir mac Laoighsigh mic Cathaoír Uí Diomusaigh.

M1489.9 Jump to heading ¶

O Neill, .i. Conn mac Enri do dhol i n-oireacht Uí Cathain. Millte mora do dhenamh dhó, & a m-braighde do thabhairt lais.

M1489.10 Jump to heading ¶

O Domnaill, .i. Aodh Ruadh mac Neill Ghairbh do dol sluagh i t-Trian Congail isin f-foghmar do sonnradh. Creacha móra & airccthe aidhbhle do denamh do isin

p.1168

Rúta ar Mac Uidhilín, & gan dioghbhail do dhenamh dó acht Conn a mac do ghuin. Dol dó iar sin co Bel Feirsde, & caislén Bheóil Feirsde do gabhail & do briseadh lais, & teacht slan dia tigh co n-edalaibh aidhbli.

M1489.11 Jump to heading ¶

O Raghallaigh Sean mac Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Seain, &

Ó Fearghail Conmhac" mac Seain mic Domhnaill do denamh

creiche h-i Maigh Breaghmhaine, & **Donnchadh mac

Briain Chaoich mic Domhnaill Bhuidhe

Uí Feargail** do marbhadh don turus-sin.

M1489.12 Jump to heading ¶

Tomaltach mac Briain Mec Donnchaidh do mharbhadh la h-**Aodh mac

Domhnaill Chaim Mec Donnchaidh**, & lá a cloinn.

M1489.13 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Feilim Fhinn (.i. O Concobhair) do gabhail

la cloinn Uí Cheallaigh.

M1489.14 Jump to heading ¶

Toirrdhealbhach mac Feilim Finn Ui Concobhair (mac tighearna a aosa as fearr tainic dia chenel re h-athaidh d'aimsir) do marbhadh la cloinn **Ruaidhri mic

Feidhlimidh** & lá mac Mec Diarmata, la sliocht

Uí Concobhair Ruaidh, & lá mac Aodha mic Ruaidhri isin Caislén Riabhach.

M1489.15 Jump to heading ¶

Comhthoccbhail coccaidh for Ua c-Conchobhair la **Ruaidhri mac

Feilim**, la sliocht Taidhg Óicc &

Taidhcc Ruaidh, & lá sliocht **Ruaidhri

Mec Diarmada**. Coimhionnsaicchidh doibh fair co h-**Ard

an Choillín**, & Mac Cathail Ruaidh Uí Conchobhair do leccadh & do bhualadh leo & a marcshluagh féin dá bhein amach co h-áithesach. Ua Conchobair féin co n-a marcsluagh & co n-a Gallócclacaibh do breith forra, & gabhála do ghabhsatar don chaoraigheacht

do bhein diobh. A lenmhain asuidhe co Tuillsce &Donnchadh Cleireach mac Taidhcc Mec Diarmata do mharbhadh lá h-Ua c-Conchobhair.

Cidh fil ann tra acht a Ghallócclacha fein do fheall & do impádh for Ua Concobhair

& a madhmucchadh leó & Mac Concobhair Bhuidhe mic Corbmaic do mharbhadh uadh

co sochaidhibh oile, & bladh da chaoraigheacht do bhuain de, & imtheacht áithesach attéchta eisiomail do denamh

d'Ua Concobair, & a chaoraigheacht do breith leis i n-Uíbh Maine.

M1489.16 Jump to heading ¶

Eoccan mac Feidhlimidh .i. Feidhlimidh mac Eoghain mic Domhnaill mic Muirceartaigh Ui Concobair mac tigherna Cairpre,

& d[acute ] mhac Muirceartaigh mic Eoghain

p.1170

(.i. Muirceartach Ócc & Sean) do mharbhadh a meabail lasan Calbhach c-Caoch mac Domhnaill mic Eóghain, & Ua Domhnaill baí a slánaibh etorra, d'orccain & do mhilleadh Cairpre a n-dioghail a mighníomh, & tré nemhchomhall a shlán & a chor.

M1489.17 Jump to heading ¶

Colmán mac Airt mic Corbmaic Bhallaigh Ui Mhaoilechlainn do mharbhadh lá Conn mac Airt mic Cuinn mic Corbmaic Bhallaigh Uí Mhaoilechlainn.

M1489.18 Jump to heading ¶

An Calbhach mac Aedha (.i. Aodh Ruadh) mic Neill Ghairbh Uí Domhnaill d'écc.

M1489.19 Jump to heading ¶

Murchadh mac Ruaidhri Mec Suibhne do mharbhadh lá h-Iarla Desmumhan (Muiris mac Tomáis) i n-**Éile

Uí Chearbhaill**, & a dearbrathair Maol Muire Mac Suibhne do ghabháil leis bheós.

M1489.20 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Még Carthaigh Diarmaid mac Taidhcc mic Domhnaill Óicc do mharbhadh lasan Iarla cédna.

M1489.21 Jump to heading ¶

Tomas Buitilér Mac Risdeird do mharbhadh lá Seaan mac Emainn Mic Risdertt Buitelér.

M1489.22 Jump to heading ¶

Risderd mac Feilim mic Feargail Uí Raghallaigh do mharbhadh lá mac Seón Óicc Ploingcéd.

M1489.23 Jump to heading ¶

Paittricín mac an Ridere Chiarraighe do mharbhadh la Mág Carthaigh Mór (Tadhg mac Domhnaill Óig).

M1489.24 Jump to heading ¶

Creach do dhenamh la **Niall & la h-Art dhá mhac Cuinn mec

Aodha Buidhe mic Briain Bhallaigh Uí Neill** ar Enrí mac Enri mic Eoghain Uí Neill, & Cathaoír Ua Conchobhair do

mharbhadh don cur-sin.

M1489.25 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Uidhilín, .i. Seinicin Ruadh mac Risdeird do mharbhadh a f-fiull lá **Ualtar mac Corbmaic mic

Seinicín mec Uidhilín**.

M1489.26 Jump to heading ¶

Mac an Bhulbaigh tighearna Criche Bulbach a c-cois Bearbha d'écc.

M1489.27 Jump to heading ¶

O Gobhann, .i. Mathghamhain mac Toirrdelbhaigh d'écc.

M1489.28 Jump to heading ¶

Diarmaid mac Briain Duibh Uí Conchobhair do mharbhadh lá h-Aodh mac Conchobhair & lá cloinn Ruaidhri mec Diarmada i n-Ath Leime na Girre, & Aedh feisin do

p.1172

ghuin go mór lá Diarmoid, & **Brian mac Concobhair mic

Uí Concobhair Ruaidh saoí thanaisi** do mharbhadh i n-a dhioghail-sen la **Tadhcc

m-Buidhe mac Cathail Ruaidh Uí Concobhair**

h-i Maigh Murchadha.

M1489.29 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Ruaidh Uí Conchobhair d'écc.

M1489.30 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór eittir an dá Ua c-Conchobhair, & Sluaiccheadh lá h-Ua c-Conchobhair Ruadh co Baile Tobair Brighde dia ro bhris badhbhdhún an bhaile,

& tangattar taoísicch slechta Taidhcc Óicc i n-a theach co ro ghiallsat dó, .i.

Ua Floinn, Mac Ceithernaigh, & Ua Maoíl Bhrénainn.

M1489.31 Jump to heading ¶

Sluaiccheadh la h-Ua c-Concobhair go Beol Coilleadh dia ro

gherr an bealach, & dia t-tuccsat lucht Airticch braighde dhó.

M1489.32 Jump to heading ¶

Breas maidhm for chloinn Uí Conchobhair isin t-Segais

la cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Diarmata.

M1489.33 Jump to heading ¶

Slóiccheadh lá h-Ua c-Conchobhair for chloinn **Uilliam

Ui Cheallaigh** dia ro loiscc, & dia ro ghearr bealach an

Chluainín, dia ro ghearr & dia ro mhill arbhanna iomdha.

Dioghbhala iomdha do dhenamh do chloinn Uilliam Uí Cheallaigh for

Ua Maol Conaire co n-a braithribh i n-a dhioghail sidhe.

M1489.34 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Ui Concobhair, & Eoccan do ghabhail a meabhail lá cloinn Uilliam Uí Cheallaigh, & Dubhthach Ua Maol Chonaire do ghabhail i n-a fochair, & a chor i n-geimhel.

M1489.35 Jump to heading ¶

Concobhar mac Diarmada do gabhail la Toirrdhealbach Ua c-Concobhair.

M1489.36 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh mór etir Anghalachaibh féin. Creacha & uilc iomdha do dhénamh dóibh for aroile co n-dearna an Iustis síth etorra & co ro rann an toísighecht eitir mac Seain & mac Cathail.

p.1174

M1489.37 Jump to heading ¶

Creach Cluana Tuaiscirt na Sionna lá sliocht Laoíghsigh mic Rossa, & creach áithesach do dhenamh i n-a díoghail i t-Tír Licin

lá Muintir Ainlighi for sliocht Loighsigh.

M1489.38 Jump to heading ¶

Maidhm siodha etir an dá Ua Fherghail, & creach mhór

do dhenamh la mac Seain for mac Cathail mic Tomais.

M1489.39 Jump to heading ¶

Mac Branáin do gairm do Shean Mac Branáin lá h-Ua Concobair & lá Mac Diarmada & do mhaith sé an lá-sin leth-marcc Bhaile an Bhealaigh do chloinn Uí Mhaoil Chonaire baí acc fior a ionaid forra lé h-aimsir imchéin.

M1489.40 Jump to heading ¶

Maelechlainn mac Lochlainn Uí Mhaol Chonaire d'écc for a chuairt éiccsi lá Mumhain.

M1489.41 Jump to heading ¶

Síle ingean Diarmata an Dúnaidh Meg Carthaigh ben Toirrdhealbhaigh Ui Bhriain díol Caisil do ríoghain d'écc.

M1489.42 Jump to heading ¶

Caoíre na Midhe a c-comhfhochraibh fairrcce ó Ath Cliath co Droichet Átha do dhol isin muir d'aimhdheoin a n-aoghairedh & gan a t-teacht for c-cúla.

M1489.43 Jump to heading ¶

O Fialán d'écc.

Annal M1490. AOIS CRIOST, 1490.

M1490.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aois Criost, mile, ceithre chéd,

nochat.

M1490.1 Jump to heading ¶

Matha Mac Conaincc biocaire Leth Ratha,

Ferccus mac Eóin mic Matha ancoire Insi Caoín,

an Cananach Mac Ticchernáin do shenadh Droma Lethain, &

Giolla Crist Mac an Fhir Leighinn saccart ócc baí i c-Cluain Lis Fhloinnabhrait d'écc.

p.1176

M1490.2 Jump to heading ¶

Creach la h-Ua c-Conchobhair i t-Tír Maine for Ruaidhri mac Toirrdhealbhaigh i Turlach na m-Bruigheol.

Creach ele lá h-Ua c-Conchobhair for cloinn Ruaidhri Bhuídhe h-i Muine Fraochnat, & h-i n-Druim Tarlach, & h-i c-Cluain Gamhnach. Clann Ruaidhri Mec Diarmata & a m-baoí 'n-a acchaidh dá chinidh féin co n-a n-Gallócclachaibh do beith ar a chionn ar Maigh na Cruachna & tachar aggarbh ainmín do thabhairt dóibh da 'roile co ro cuimhnighsiot a

sen fholta & a nuafholta da cheile, ar batar daoine ainnsidhe i n-aghaidh aroile las ro marbhadh aithre & braithre a chéle. Cidh tra acht ro sraoineadh lá h-Ua Concobhair forra annsin, & do marbhadh ann

Tomaltach mac Ruaidhri Mec Diarmada tanaisi Maighe Luirg, & Corbmac mac Taidhg mic Ruaidhri Buidhe. Ro gabhadh ann Donnchadh mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Mec Dubgaill, & sochaidhe da n-Gallócclachaibh & dáM c-ceithirn.

M1490.3 Jump to heading ¶

**O Conchobhair Feilim Fionn mac Taidhcc mic

Toirrdhealbhaigh Ruaidh Uí Chonchobhair** fear crodha coccthach fer

ro dhing a omhan for gach tir i n-a timcheall, & fear ro shaoílset

Síol Muiredhaigh do chor Connacht lé cheile d'écc Luan Cascc

i t-tigh Mecc Oireachtaigh, & a adhnacal i n-otharlicche a shinnsior h-i

Ros Comain.

M1490.4 Jump to heading ¶

Toirrdhealbhach mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Uí Bhaoighill do

trasccradh dia eoch a c-coimhling for iomaire Murbhaigh & a

écc as a los.

M1490.5 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Gairmledhaigh Muirceartach mac Enri mic Concobhair, & Concobhar Ruadh mac Giolla Patraicc Meg Uidhir d'ecc.

M1490.6 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri mac Pilip mic Con Connacht do mharbhadh lá cloinn Bhriain mic Concobhair Óicc Meg Uidhir & la sliocht Concobhair archena.

M1490.7 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Cathain Sean mac Aibhne mic Diarmata do ghabhail la luing tainig a h-Inber Air.

M1490.8 Jump to heading ¶

Aodh mac Maoil Morda mic Seaain Uí Raghallaigh do ghabhail la cloinn Glaisne mic Conchobhair Uí Raghallaigh iar n-orccain

bhaile Tomais mic Glaisne leis.

p.1178

M1490.9 Jump to heading ¶

Sémus Ócc Sabhaois do mharbhadh la cloinn an t-Sionasccail Sabhaoís.

M1490.10 Jump to heading ¶

Colla mac Rúdhraighe mic Ardgail Meg Mathgamna do mharbhadh lá sliocht Con Uladh mic Neill Mhóir Uí Neill.

M1490.11 Jump to heading ¶

Feilim mac Rudhraighe mic Seinicín Mec Uidhilín do mharbhadh i n-Aendruim lá cloinn Briain mic Aodha.

M1490.12 Jump to heading ¶

Caislén **Édain

Dubhcairrcce**, .i. caislén Neill mic Cuinn mec Aodha Buidhe do ghabháil & do bhriseadh lá Feilim mac mic Neill Buidhe, & creacha móra la **Feilim mac mic Uí Neill

Bhuide** ar cloinn Cuinn mec Aedha Buidhe,

& Gofraidh Ua Maol Craoíbhe do mharbhadh leiss.

M1490.13 Jump to heading ¶

Creacha & oirgne do dhenomh la h-Aedh Óg mac Aodha Ruaidh Uí Dhomhnaill ar cloinn Donnchaidh mic Aedha Meg Uidhir, & a m-breith lais co h-Ath Senaigh & a marbhadh ann uile,

.i. ceithre chéd bó, uair tucsat bardadha an bhaile (clann **Aodha Gallda

Uí Dhomnaill**) caislén Atha Senaigh d'Aodh Ócc

gan comhairlécchadh d'Ua Domhnaill.

M1490.14 Jump to heading ¶

O Domhnaill & Ó Neill do beith i n-díbh scoraibh for aineach aroile ó

Shamhain go Nodlaicc, O Domhnaill i n-Druim Bó &

ó Neill isin c-Cairrccín, & ní dearnsat sídh na ossadh, coccadh na comhfhuachadh frisan ré-sin.

p.1180

M1490.15 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Dálaigh Breifne, Sean mac Uilliam mic Aodha saoí lé dán, Ruaidhri & Aodh Mhág Craith

da mhac Domhnaill mic Aodha Óicc dá priomh-shaoí Cloinne Craith, **Tomás Ua Lorcáin

adhbhar ollamhan Ua Madadháin**, & Fionn Ua h-Anghluinn primh-thiompánach Ereann d'écc.

M1490.16 Jump to heading ¶

Ua h-Uiccinn Sean mac Fergail Óicc priomh-shaoí Ereann lé dán d'écc.

M1490.17 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Caiside Cúile, & Catariona inghen Choncobhair mic Cathail Meg Raghnaill ben Taidhcc mic Toirrdhealbhaigh Még Uidhir d'écc.

M1490.18 Jump to heading ¶

Donnchadh mac Maoileachlainn Chaoích Ui Bhirn co n-a dhís mac, fer dhíobh a c-cionn a sheacht m-bliadhan do marbhadh a meabhail lásan c-cuid oile do sliocht Corbmaic Uí Birn.

M1490.19 Jump to heading ¶

Cathal mac Donnchaidh mic Aodha do marbhadh la Conn Ciotach mac Aodha mic Eoghain, & la muintir Concobhair Mic Diarmada i t-Tír Bhriúin na Sionna.

M1490.20 Jump to heading ¶

Sliocht **Taidhcc Uí

Concobhair** co n-a c-caoraigheacht do

theacht a h-Uíbh Maine, & suidhe dóibh i n-ucht an

Chláir, & **Tadhcc Ruadh mac Cairpre

Uí Concobhair** do gabhail leó. Indsaighidh lá cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Diarmata fó n-a c-caoraighecht-somh i n-adhaidh-sin fein, & Ruaidhri mac Corbmaic Mec Diarmada do marbhadh lasan ionnsaighidh-sin.

M1490.21 Jump to heading ¶

Ruaidhri mac Feilim Uí Concobhair d'oirdneadh i n-ionadh Fhéilim Fhinn.

M1490.22 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Domhnaill do theacht lá sliocht **Taidhcc Uí

Conchobhair** co Tuillsce, & an caislén d'fheimghedh dóibh.

M1490.23 Jump to heading ¶

Creach lá sliocht Taidhcc Uí Chonchobhair for Ua c-Concobhair, & for cloinn Ruaidhri Mec Diarmada i m-bóthar liath Baislice.

M1490.24 Jump to heading ¶

Sliocht Taidhcc Uí Concobhair, & **Tadhg

Ruadh** do dhol co n-a c-caoraigheacht i Maigh Luircc, & a ghuirt do ghearradh &

a n-ullmhucchadh dóibh fein and, & a dhaoíne féin do dhíochur ass.

p.1182

M1490.25 Jump to heading ¶

Slóiccheadh lá sliocht Taidhcc Uí Concobhair & lá Mac Uilliam Búrc for sliocht Briain Bhallaigh Uí Conchobhair & a c-caislén do gabail & iad féin do dhíbirt as a n-dúthaigh.

M1490.26 Jump to heading ¶

Creach lá Fergus mac Emainn mic Laoighsigh for Feargus mac Cathail mic Tomais & for Cloinn Amhlaoibh.

Crech ele lais for Ua Maoileachlainn. Crech ele lais isin

Cuirrín Chonnachtach for cloinn **Giolla na Naomh mic

Domhnaill**.

M1490.27 Jump to heading ¶

**Emann Dubh mac Rossa tighearna

Chaladh na h-Anghaile** d'écc, & Feidhlimidh mac Giolla na Naomh mic Domhnaill do gabháil a ionaid.

M1490.28 Jump to heading ¶

Diarmait Buidhe mac Uí Ainlighi do mharbhadh lá

Ferccus mac Emainn i c-Coill na Cloiche,

& Ua h-Ainlighi a athair, .i. Tadhg mac Giolla na Naomh do dhalladh dia cumhaidh. Ua h-Ainlighi do ghairm do Mhuircheartach mac Uaitne Uí Ainlighi i

n-a ionad.

M1490.29 Jump to heading ¶

Siubhan inghen Murchaidh mic Taidhcc Glai bean Domhnaill Meg Cormáin d'écc.

M1490.30 Jump to heading ¶

Maoilechlainn mac Uilliam Uí Cheallaigh do gabhail a

meabhail lá Tadhcc mac Donnchaidh Uí Cheallaigh & mac Uí Mhainnín do mharbhadh i n-a fhiadhnaise &

Maoíleachlainn do léiccean iar t-trioll.

M1490.31 Jump to heading ¶

**Emann Díolmhain tighearna

Machaire Cuircne** d'écc.

M1490.32 Jump to heading ¶

Brian mac Taidhcc (.i. Mag Raghnaill) mic Cathail Óicc Meg Raghnaill do mharbhadh a meabhail i Liath Druim lá sliocht a sheanathar fein (.i. Tadg mac Concobhair & da mhac

Maoilechlainn) bai i n-a n-daltaibh ag á athair.

p.1184

M1490.33 Jump to heading ¶

Caislén Liath Droma do ghabhail la Hoiberd mac Taidhg Mhég Raghnaill, & lá sliocht **Tomaltaigh

Mec Diarmata**, Cathal mac Mhaoílechlainn Meg Raghnaill do marbhadh

isin c-caislen la Hoiberd a n-dioghail a dhearbhrathar. Caislén **Liath

Droma** do gabhail d'Eoghan Ua Ruairc iar sin.

M1490.34 Jump to heading ¶

Caislen Atha Luain do gabhail don Diolmaineach.

M1490.35 Jump to heading ¶

**Geralt mac Dúnlaing Uí Bhrain tighearna

Branach** d'écc & Catháoír Ua Broin i n-a

ionad.

M1490.36 Jump to heading ¶

Eoin Ócc mac Eoin Mhóir a h-Íle

do mharbhadh a mebail lá fear téd Ultach bai i n-a gradhaibh fein Diarmait Mag Cairpre, & boill do dhenam de fein i n-a chionaidh.

M1490.37 Jump to heading ¶

Fionnghuala inghen Ruaidhri Meg Con Mara ben Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Murchaidh Uí Briain d'écc.

M1490.38 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac Domhnaill Uí Concobhair Corc Mo Dhruadh do marbhadh la Cathal mac Uí Concobhair.

M1490.39 Jump to heading ¶

Maidhm talmhan do thóbhruchtadh h-i Sleib Gamh dia ro mucchadh ced do dhaoinibh im mac Maghnusa Crosaigh Uí Egra, & lás ro marbhadh capaill & bú iomda, & iascc brén iomdha do thecht amach as & loch i n-a n-gabar iascc do fhás i n-a ionad.

p.1186

Annal M1491. AOIS CRIOST, 1491.

M1491.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aoís Criost, míle, ceithre ced

nóchat, a h-aon.

M1491.1 Jump to heading ¶

Eoghan mac Muirceartaigh mic Neill Óicc Uí Néill Muirceartach mac Airt mic Eoghain Uí Neill, & Sean Ruadh mac Ruaidhri Meg Uidhir

d'écc.

M1491.2 Jump to heading ¶

O Cathain, .i. Sean mac Aibhne mic Diarmatta do léiccean as a braighdenus & a chaoraighecht do bhein dó do chloinn Mhagnusa Uí Cathain suil do fhidir neach dia thir fein a legean amach.

M1491.3 Jump to heading ¶

Feidlimidh mac Aodha mic Eoghain Uí Neill do mharbhadh la Brian mac Rudhraighe mic Emainn Meg Mathghamna, & Art Ua Neill dearbrathair Fheidhlimidh do denamh creiche i t-**Teallach

n-Geallaccain** i n-a dioghail. Daoine iomdha do losccadh, & do mharbhadh leis.

M1491.4 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh anbháil etir Ua Neill, .i. Conn mac Enri, & **Ua

Domhnaill .i. Aodh Ruadh mac Neill Gairbh**

co na ro fédadh a siodhuccadh co n-dechsat araon do shaicchidh an Iustís Iarla Cille Dara, & a t-toidhecht uadh for cula gan sidh gan ossadh. Brian mac Aodha Gallda mic Neill Uí Domhnaill do marbhadh ar an c-coccadh-sin lá Henrí mac Enri Uí Neill. Ro coimhéid & ro imdegail an t-Enri cedna an tir a c-cein ro baoí Ó Neill h-i t-tigh gall.

M1491.5 Jump to heading ¶

Eachmhilidh mac Még Aongusa .i. mac Aodha mic Airt do marbhadh i n-a tigh fein ar greis oidhche la cloinn Maoilechlainn mic Muircertaigh mic Eoghain Uí Neill.

M1491.6 Jump to heading ¶

Ua Raghallaigh (Sean mac Toirrdhealbhaigh mic Seain)

macaomh ócc aoidheadhach dearlaictheach deagheinigh do ecc h-i remhthus a ratha, & a adhnacail i mainistir an Cabhain, & Ua Ragallaigh do gairm do Shean mac Cathail mic Eoghain.

M1491.7 Jump to heading ¶

Cathal mac Toirrdhealbhaigh Uí Raghallaigh do tharraing

Iarla Cille Dara ar Ua Raghallaigh Ócc

co n-a braithribh & dioghbhala móra arbha, & innile, & airneisi do denamh lasan sluagh n-Gall. don tír, & Mac Mec Balronta do gabháil ón t-sluagh Gall lá cloind Cathail, & mac

Emainn mic Tomais mic Feidhlim Uí Raghallaigh do marbhadh

lásan sluagh h-isin.

p.1188

M1491.8 Jump to heading ¶

Creacha mhóra lasan Iarla (Semus mac Tomáis)

ar cloinn Glaisne mic Concobhair Ui Raghallaigh.

M1491.9 Jump to heading ¶

Mag Craith h-i Tearmann do dhenamh do

Ruaidhri mac Diarmata mic Marcais.

M1491.10 Jump to heading ¶

Aedh & Ruaidhri da mac **Domnaill mic Aodha Óicc mic Aodha

mic Raghnaill mic Donnchaidh Alainn Még Craith** d'écc.

M1491.11 Jump to heading ¶

Murchadh mac Eogain Még Craith d'écc.

M1491.12 Jump to heading ¶

Hanri mac Hoiberd mic Semais Diolmhain do mharbhadh a athar

feisin Hoberd d'erchor do sgin & é

fein do dol dochum na Romha as a los.

M1491.13 Jump to heading ¶

Fliuchdhoinenn mhór h-i samhradh na bliadhna-sa & isin

fhoghmhar ar cind go m-ba samhalta fri dílinn go ro

mheth arbhanna na h-Erenn.

Annal M1492. AOIS CRIOST, 1492.

M1492.0 Jump to heading ¶

Aoís Criost, mile, cethre ched, nochat, a

dó.

M1492.1 Jump to heading ¶

An t-Oificel Ó Duibhidhir .i. Aodh d'écc.

M1492.2 Jump to heading ¶

**Ruaidhri (.i. Ua Concobhair Ruadh) mac Feidhlimidh Uí

Concobair**, fer sona re sídh, fear crodha ré coccadh d'écc iar sendataidh tocchaidhe & a adhnacal

h-i t-Tuillscce.

M1492.3 Jump to heading ¶

**O h-Áinlighi Giolla na Naemh mac Domhnaill taoíseach

Cenél Dobhtha** do mharbhadh la a chenel feisin.

M1492.4 Jump to heading ¶

Coccadh adhbal mhór etir **Ua Raghallaigh Ócc .i.

Sean mac Cathail mic Eoghain & Cathal mac Toirrdhealbhaigh mic

Seain mic Eoghain**, do-rónadh creacha mora la **Cathal for

Ua n-Gobhann**. O Gobhann dia lenmhain, & a écc suil do

impaídh.

p.1190

Síth & osadh do denamh eitir Ua n-Domhnaill & O Neill go

Beltainne.

M1492.6 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac Airt mic Cuinn Uí Conchobhair do mharbhadh

lá muintir Iarla Cille Dara tre urchor

cuaille tucc sé ar succradh ar an Iarla.

p.1192

M1492.7 Jump to heading ¶

Conn mac Uí Dhomhnaill do geimhliucchadh lá a athair.

Sean mac Cairpre Uí Neill do marbhadh la cloinn h-**Ui

Anluain** & lá cloinn Remainn Uí Anluain h-i t-**Traigh

Baile Dúine Dealccan**.
